messages:
sara: Heads up — running the compliance query for the last 24h and I see role.assign / role.remove events missing for ~12 minutes after last night's perm-sync. Some audit rows have actor: null. Anyone else seeing this or know if perm-sync had issues?

deploy-bot: perm-sync job completed 2024-11-02T03:12:06Z (job id ps-47).

prakash: that was my rollout. we pushed the cross-region perm-sync at ~03:10. did you query primary ES or the raw S3?

sara: queried audit-svc ES index. sample query I ran: ```GET /audit-*/_search {"query":{"term":{"event_type":"role.assign"}}, "range":{"timestamp":{"gte":"now-1d/d"}}}``` — results show a gap between 03:10 and 03:22, and several entries in that window either missing or with actor:null.

lina: noted we rotated the KMS key at 02:59 UTC. could the rotation have affected the audit envelope signing or the decrypt step that enriches actor metadata?

jon: if audit-svc can't decrypt identity tokens it will skip enrichment. check audit-svc logs for decrypt errors around 03:10-03:20.

prakash: our perm-sync writes signed identity tokens now. if decrypt fails we should fallback to service-account, but iirc the eu-west rollout didn't include the fallback yet. i'll check the rollout notes.

audit-bot: alert: 1842004321 - audit-svc detected 24 failed KMS decrypt operations between 2024-11-02T03:11:00Z and 2024-11-02T03:18:00Z; sample ids: [a1b2c3d4, c3d4e5f6].

sara: we need to be able to produce a forensics timeline for compliance. can we reconstruct who initiated the sync from CI / git history if audit events are missing? also need to know which customer changes might intersect.

lina: i can pull the CI run + commit sha. @prakash which service account executed the job?

prakash: sync executed by github-actions[bot] via infra/perm-sync@main commit 7f9c2a. service account infra-sync@redwood-prod. i'm re-running a small replay locally to see if actor gets attached with current key.

jon: short-term mitigation: enable audit-svc feature flag "legacy-actor-fill" to populate actor from service-account header so we don't record null. that buys time for a proper fix.

sara: :thumbsup: please also add a note to the compliance ticket and mark this incident P2. quarterly audit in 5 days so we need a clean trail or an explainable gap.

prakash: will open a hotfix PR to fail-open on decrypt so events still ingest (with service-account) instead of dropping actor metadata. drafting now.

lina: if we still have raw event batches in S3 we can re-ingest once keys are verified. i'll prepare the replay plan and list steps for the compliance artifact.

sara: action items: 1) prakash: hotfix + PR and roll; 2) lina: prepare S3 replay plan and record CI sha; 3) jon: enable legacy-actor-fill until hotfix lands; 4) sara: update compliance ticket and draft auditor note. we'll do a postmortem in #eng-security after replay.

prakash: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/825 (draft). re-run started locally.

deploy-bot: perm-sync replay queued ps-47-replay by infra-sync, eta ~12m.

sara: thanks all — keep updates here. if we need to produce a signed statement for auditors about "temporary metadata loss during KMS rotation" i'll draft and circulate for legal sign-off.

jon: i checked audit-svc logs: decrypt errors show KMS key id mismatch on a small subset, looks like propagation delay across regions. will include log excerpts in the postmortem.

prakash: re-run attached actor now present in replayed events locally. will push hotfix to canary then prod.

sara: perfect. capture timestamps and hashes for the compliance artifact and tag this incident in the quarterly audit ticket.

lina: adding S3 path for raw events to the ticket: s3://redwood-audit-raw/2024/11/02/ps-47-raw.ndjson

sara: assigning follow-ups in ticket and setting a blocker until replayed events are re-ingested. thanks everyone.
